clothing_restriction.value: Dark color clothing with shoulders covered; must not bear any form of military or civil servant badges or ornaments

expression_restriction.value: Neutral facial expression, not smiling, mouth must be closed

ears_visibility.value: Hairline and ears must be visible and not covered

face_visibility.value: Full face view; applicant must be facing the camera directly

headwear_policy.value: Covering of the head is prohibited unless for medical or religious purposes; a formal written request must be submitted and approved by the Passport Department (epassportoffice@bahamas.gov.bs)

accessories.value: Makeup should be neutral and jewelry modest

validity.value: No more than six (6) months old at the time of application

file_spec.value: JPEG/PNG/BMP format accepted for digital copy submission

clothing.en: Clothing should be dark in color with shoulders covered; must not bear any military or civil servant badges or ornaments
clothing.ko: 복장은 어두운 색상으로 어깨가 가려지도록 착용해야 하며, 군복이나 공무원 제복의 배지·장식은 금지
clothing.ja: 服装は濃い色で肩が隠れるように着用すること。軍や公務員の記章・装飾品の着用は禁止

expression.en: Neutral facial expression, not smiling, mouth must be closed
expression.ko: 무표정(중립적 표정)을 유지해야 하며 미소는 금지, 입은 다문 상태를 유지
expression.ja: 無表情(中立的な表情)を保ち、笑顔は不可、口は閉じること

ears.en: Hairline and ears must be visible and not covered
ears.ko: 헤어라인과 귀가 가려지지 않고 보여야 함
ears.ja: 生え際と耳が隠れず見えること

face_visibility.en: Full face view required; applicant must be facing the camera directly
face_visibility.ko: 정면 전체 얼굴이 나와야 하며 카메라를 똑바로 응시해야 함
face_visibility.ja: 顔全体が正面から写っていること。カメラを真っ直ぐ見ること

headwear.en: Head covering is prohibited unless for medical or religious purposes, subject to a formal written request approved by the Passport Department
headwear.ko: 머리 가림은 의료 또는 종교적 목적을 제외하고 금지되며, 예외 시 여권사무국(Passport Department)에 서면 승인 요청이 필요
headwear.ja: 頭部の被り物は医療上または宗教上の理由を除き禁止。例外の場合はパスポート局への書面申請と承認が必要

accessories.en: Makeup should be neutral and jewelry modest
accessories.ko: 메이크업은 자연스럽게, 액세서리(장신구)는 과하지 않게 착용
accessories.ja: メイクは控えめに、アクセサリーは控えめなものを着用

background.evidence: White background confirmed on both mofa.gov.bs/passportrenewal/ (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) and independently on bahamas.gov.bs government services portal, which additionally specifies 3 color photographs required.
